title: Install, recover, or migrate Todo
summary: Initialize or migrate Todo's database, or deploy, validate, diagnose, and recover the user-owned macOS installation and daily email service.
use_when: Todo storage must be initialized or upgraded through its supported backup-bearing migrator.
The installed CLI, content-addressed release, configuration, database, or daily email LaunchAgent must be deployed or diagnosed.
do_not_use_when: The task is normal Todo domain use.
A database backup destination already exists or is relative for a required version-one migration.
The user has not authorized an installed-state or service change.
outcome: A validated current Todo database and user-owned installation with explicit backup, rollback, configuration, Nucleus, email, and service state.
effects: Initialization creates a new empty database and refuses to replace an existing path.
Migration creates a retained complete backup before the version-two transaction; current databases are true no-ops.
Deployment stages and switches content-addressed releases, may migrate the database, rewrites installed configuration when requested, and installs or updates the daily email LaunchAgent.
Deployment rollback can restore captured database, release, configuration, plist, and loaded-service state before commit.
authority: Todo owns its SQLite schema, migration, installation, configuration, and email LaunchAgent.
Nucleus remains separately authoritative for research execution and authentication; Resend remains authoritative for email submission.
success: The selected database is current and inspectable, and any required pre-migration backup remains at the explicit caller-owned path.
The installed CLI smoke test, Nucleus readiness, email preview/send validation, and LaunchAgent status are checked as applicable.
A failed pre-commit update restores the exact captured installed state.
failure_and_recovery: Ordinary commands never migrate implicitly; stop callers and use the supported migrator.
On interrupted deployment, inspect the deployer's rollback result, selected release, database, configuration, plist, and loaded service before retrying.
Do not infer 09:00 delivery while the Mac is off or the user is logged out; a user LaunchAgent cannot guarantee it.
privacy: The Todo database, migration backups, configuration, and logs can expose directions, notes, paths, design state, and email metadata.
`RESEND_API_KEY` remains in the process environment and `~/.zshrc`; Nucleus credentials remain outside Todo.
does_not_authorize: Deleting retained Todo database, backups, logs, or releases.
Changing the Resend account or exposing its API key.
